text.p: Rhone-Poulenc said its third quarter results would be published in the morning of Friday October 25.
Financial analysts contacted by Reuters had no precise forecasts for the results with quarterly figures being very difficult to predict.
The market consensus for the full year, as established by Jacques Chahine Finance on October 15, is for an earnings per share figure of 8.7 francs and 11.2 francs for 1997.
The 1996 figure has been recently downgraded after the company made a profit warning saying that a product recall by a joint-venture of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer and Hoechst would impact its profits.
The company said the 1996 figure could be six to seven percent below analysts' forecast for 1996.
Rhone-Poulenc said on Thursday it planned to sell its Novacarb soda ash unit to Harris Chemical Group.
Brokers Ferri put a value of 500 to 800 million francs on the Novacarb business and has a "2" recommendation, which means buy.
